items.title: Best Ph.D. Thesis Award, IIT Guwahati
items.body: The thesis "The Role of Metamaterials in Improving Magnetic Resonance Imaging" received the Institute's Best Ph.D. Thesis Award at the 28th Convocation.

items.title: Joined the Berlin Ultrahigh Field Facility
items.body: Started as RF Scientist at B.U.F.F., Max Delbrück Center for Molecular Medicine, in Prof. Thoralf Niendorf's group, working on RF coils and applicators for ultrahigh-field and thermal magnetic resonance.

items.title: Indian Patent No. 583980 granted
items.body: "A Metasurface-inspired Flexible Structure for Boosting the Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) in 1.5T MRI Scans" — the second granted patent underpinning Meta Samadhan's flexi-wrap technology.

items.title: Indian Patent No. 579702 granted
items.body: "A Magnetic Metamaterial Add-on for Improving the Signal-to-Noise Ratio of Magnetic Resonance Imaging".

items.title: New paper in Applied Physics A
items.body: "Smart and Flexible Metasurface-Inspired Wraps as 'Add-ons' for Enhanced Magnetic Resonance Imaging" — switchable wraps that boost the received field without modifying the scanner.

items.title: Best Paper Award at IEEE GCON 2025
items.body: Awarded for work on switchable metasurface wraps of interconnected rectangular windings, presented at the IEEE Guwahati Subsection Conference in Itanagar.
